overview.label: Story
overview.heading: Overview
overview.body: A joy-driven 3D motion piece — a camera-choreographed animation and rendered stills that give a brand’s emotional core room to move. Built as a self-contained piece, from concept and camera direction through to final render.

problem.label: Problem
problem.heading: Why this needed to exist
problem.body: Turn a feeling — joy — into something tangible, with no product or interface to anchor the story to.

approach.label: Approach
approach.heading: How the work got done
approach.body: Directed the piece end-to-end — concept, camera choreography, lighting, and asset direction — iterating on renders until the tone landed.

outcomes.label: Outcomes
outcomes.heading: What changed once it shipped
outcomes.body: A finished 3D camera animation and rendered stills, ready to carry the brand across motion and marketing.

credits.label: Credits
credits.heading: One last thing
credits.body: A joy-driven 3D motion piece — a camera-choreographed animation and rendered stills that give a brand’s emotional core room to move.
